name: Greyhearth
descriptionSeed: Greyhearth — the burying trades, the mourning trades and the quiet ones. A town that buries for every road that meets here — the Crossing's dead and the Palelands' both — and does not find it grim: everyone here has handled a body or sung over one, which makes it the most matter-of-fact place in the Valley about the thing everyone else will not name.
encounterFlavor: traders, apprentices and people from three domains who have learned to share a street

substrateSource.reason: Ashwardens have attended endings on this hearth for a long time, and an ending attended properly leaves a residue. The grey in the name is not soot.
substrateSource.radiusNote: `radius` is in legacy map units; `radiusWorld` is RADII on the sphere and is the one mechanics should use. Chosen by sweep against the authored worldPos: at this scale all 26 sources resolve on the correct side of their region baseline and calibration drift stays ~0.05. Larger radii blanket a whole region (a source at ~55% strength everywhere inside it) and renormalization cancels the field flat — the failure CCode measured and reverted.

axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180). ⚠️ Every component is |0.45| or less by construction: a foothill is not extreme on any axis, which is what distinguishes it from its pole capital.
worldPosNote: ⚠️ THE LITERAL MIDPOINT between the Crossing and the_quiet_ground, taking the short way round on longitude. The world position states the philosophy: a foothill sits half the distance out from the centre toward its pole, and the geography and the fiction say the same thing.
